weapon:revealed.note: the star rule (Host 12.11): one OUR-side outline star_pop alone, no thrown star bits

checkpoint:reached.note: the star rule (Host 12.11): no star at a checkpoint (it can sit near a defeat); a dust puff only

draught.note: cells/s; the tunnel air moves to the right and a little up. Each effect moves by drift + draught * draughtScale (draughtScale defaults to 0). A level may override it.

budget.note: the render agent measured batch:fxNormal at 0.85 ms a frame, 6.2 ms peaks, in the missile cascade (many large alpha sprites over each other). Keep the live counts under these caps; when a cap is hit, drop parts by priority (3 first, then 2; 1 never) and let the OLDEST smoke of the same kind dither out first (jump to the last third of its clip), never pop it.
budget.fxNormalMaxAreaNote: sum of live normal sprites areas in cells^2 (a smoke_linger_big is 16, an explosion_huge 56)

heat_shimmer.use: NOT a sprite. A displacement map at 16 px a cell that tiles in y. In a pass that sees the scene behind the fx (a copy of the frame so far, or the layers below fxFront), offset each screen pixel inside this quad by ((R - 128) / 127, (G - 128) / 127) * amplitudePx * (B / 255) * fade art pixels, snapped to whole art pixels; scroll the map up by scrollCellsPerS. fade = 1 during hold, then down to 0 over fadeOut. The quad bottom sits on the event point plus offset (cells, y up). Without such a pass, skip it (priority 3); nothing else depends on it.
